editor.title: Photo tags and description
editor.intro: Tags decide which posts the photo gets attached to. Pick 1–4.
editor.descriptionPlaceholder: E.g. Owner Petr — always in a blue shirt in photos
editor.descriptionHelp: The engine gets this sentence with every post that uses the photo. Write what is not visible: name, role, material, where it is.
editor.personNote: 👤 The engine will keep this face across posts — it will not replace it with a stock model.

person.label: Specific person
person.hint: a portrait of ONE specific person of the brand (owner, face of the brand) — not a crowd, not a group

people.label: People in general
people.hint: customers, a crowd, a group photo without a specific brand face

exterior.label: Exterior
exterior.hint: outdoor shot of the building, facade, entrance

product.label: Product
product.hint: a shot of a specific product, goods, item

detail.label: Detail
detail.hint: detail, texture, macro shot WITHOUT a recognisable face

info.tip: 💡 Tip: Upload product photos — the AI places them into real scenes instead of generating from scratch.
info.face: 👤 Face of the brand: Tag a portrait of a specific person as Specific person — the engine then keeps them across posts instead of a stock model.
info.tags: 🏷️ Fixing tags: Click the tags under a photo. A manual tag is never overwritten by the AI — not even with “Retag with AI”.
info.environment: 🏙️ Places: Photos of your shop or office help keep behind-the-scenes posts authentic.
